section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measures and instruments used in the study. It details seven measurement tools: the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) to assess body appreciation, the Caregiver Eating Messages Scale (CEMS) to measure perceived eating-related messages from caregivers, the Experiences in Close Relationships Scale (ECRS) for adult attachment, the Almost Perfect Scale-Revised (APS-R) for perfectionism, the Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II) for depressive symptoms, the Intuitive Eating Scale (IES) for intuitive eating, and self-reported weight and height for BMI calculation (M = 23.1, SD = 4.8). No explicit study numbering is provided, suggesting a single study context.
